$comment: Design tokens v1 (UX specialist 11). Brand-neutral placeholder palette: the owner's brand overrides color.light/dark.primary* + brand.* at runtime (admin > Brand). Shape is consumed by apps/web/scripts/gen-tokens.mjs: color.{light,dark} = name -> #hex ONLY; radius; shadow.{light,dark}. Everything else (font, space, breakpoints, motion, layout, miniapp) is documentation + source for CSS/Tailwind. Contrast of every text pair verified by scripts/research/11_contrast.py (WCAG 2.2 AA).

brand.note: Placeholder from PlatformParams.brand; replace through settings, never hard-code in components.

semanticUse.primary: main actions, links, selected state, focus ring
semanticUse.success: payment confirmed, delivered, risk label low, price went DOWN
semanticUse.warning: quote about to expire, risk label medium, price went UP slightly, SLA at risk
semanticUse.danger: payment mismatch, failed, risk label high, kill switch, destructive actions
semanticUse.info: neutral notices (rate refreshed, bank holiday settlement lag)
semanticUse.accent: rush / express tiers and capacity chips (never used for warnings)
semanticUse.line-strong: input borders and control outlines (>= 3:1 against bg and surface); decorative dividers use line

rules: Never convey state by colour alone: every status chip has an icon + text.
Risk label colours map low=success, medium=warning, high=danger and always carry the Persian word (copy keys risk.low/medium/high).
Price direction arrows: up = warning colour (not danger) because a rate move is information, not an error.

font.source: Self-hosted Vazirmatn variable woff2 from the npm package (SIL OFL 1.1). No Google Fonts or CDN: blocked/slow networks must still render. Subset to Arabic + Latin + digits for the critical path.

numeric.digits: Persian (U+06F0-U+06F9) for display; inputs accept Persian, Arabic-Indic and Latin digits and normalise to Latin before submit

font.zwnj: Use U+200C (نیم‌فاصله) in compounds (می‌شود, سفارش‌ها). Lint rule in scripts/research/11_build_copy.py flags 'می ' + verb patterns.

breakpoints.note: Design mobile-first at 360px (smallest Telegram/Bale viewport we support). Admin panel is desktop-first from 1024px but must stay usable at 768px for operators on tablets.

rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion (disable shimmer, count-up and slide animations).
No animation on price numbers except a 200ms highlight when the value changes.
Countdown ring updates once per second; no pulsing urgency effects.

miniapp.note: Inside Telegram/Bale the page blends with host theme: map host themeParams onto our semantic tokens when present, else use our own light/dark. Our semantic colours (success/warning/danger/risk) are NEVER overridden by the host.
miniapp.blendPolicy: Apply mapped host values only if the resulting text/background pairs still pass the contrast table (runtime check with the same formula); otherwise fall back to our tokens for that pair.
miniapp.provenance: Telegram theme parameter names from practitioner knowledge of the Mini Apps API (core.telegram.org/bots/webapps was EGRESS_BLOCKED and the search budget was exhausted in this run): confidence medium, UNVERIFIED. Bale uses window.Bale.WebApp; whether it exposes the same themeParams is UNVERIFIED (see ux-spec section 9).

tailwindHints.icons: Mirror directional icons (arrow, chevron, back) in RTL; do not mirror logos, clocks, media controls, or numerals
